response.text:
Two documents in your records expire within the next six months:

- **Residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis)** – expires Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. Make sure the extension application is filed at or before this date; without a timely request, lawful residence status ends when the permit expires. Ordnung's note also points out that applying in time usually keeps your status valid while the office decides (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG) — ask for a *Fiktionsbescheinigung* [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

- **Passport** – expires Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse]. This date needs checking against the letter. Note: renewing a passport can take months, and a residence permit usually only runs as long as the passport is valid, so it's worth renewing in good time [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse].

No other expiring documents or permits are recorded for this period.
